Job Description:The Plant Biology Innovation Greenhouse (PBIG) is seeking a self-motivated student worker to assist with research project setup and teardown and facility sanitation. Duties include autoclaving, cleaning floors and drains, washing pots, emptying trash, cleaning and inspecting equipment, reshelving materials, reporting needed repairs, mixing fertilizer, assisting with project setup and teardown, cutting custom materials with a laser cutter, and other similar tasks as assigned.
Requirements:Must be able to work in an environment that gets hot, humid, and wet. Must have good communication skills and will need to be self-motivated to work independently. This position requires frequent lifting of 30-40 pounds to approximately chest height, as well as occasional lifting of 50 pounds to waist height. Also requires frequent standing, walking, bending, kneeling, carrying, and lifting. Reliable transportation to the facility in research park is required. Free parking and bike racks are available on site. Nearest bus routes are approximately 0.1 to 0.5 miles from the facility. Must be available to work Fall, Winter, Spring, and Summer semesters for a minimum of 8 hours per week Monday-Friday. Must be available during holiday breaks for limited hours.
Skills:Previous greenhouse or field work, or an interest in plants appreciated, but not necessary.
